title: Heliox OS releases
description: Verified release milestones generated from the Heliox daemon changelog.

items.title: Heliox OS 0.11.1 — Adaptive Companion Release
items.summary: The complete v0.11 companion feature set with deterministic Windows packaging
items.content_text: Reliable Windows Release Delivery: The Windows release pipeline now prefetches and checksum-verifies WiX with explicit retries before building MSI and NSIS installers.

items.title: Heliox OS 0.9.0 — JARVIS Autonomy
items.summary: Background autonomy and local multimodal control
items.content_text:
Autonomous Background Tasks: Run permission-gated multi-step tasks while continuing to use the app.
Live Execution Narrator: Optionally hear short progress descriptions and risk interruptions.
Local Voice, Gesture, and Gaze Inputs: Use on-device multimodal controls without sending camera frames.
